_conforms_to.spec: validates against harness/schemas/RCA.json. Diagnostic substrate output (stubbed_agents).

evidence.finding: ptp4l reports SYNCHRONIZED with nominal master_offset_ns. Software view says PTP is fine.
phc2sys reports monotonic PPB drift growing despite ptp4l SYNCHRONIZED state.
tx_hwtstamp_timeouts climbing without LLDP or host-service correlation.
ice 1.11.17 matches Intel KB 730421 PHC regression; fixed in 1.13.7+.

candidate_classifications.rationale: Divergence between software-LOCKED (ptp4l SYNCHRONIZED) and hardware-NOT-OK (phc2sys monotonic drift plus rising tx_hwtstamp_timeouts) is the diagnostic signature for driver-side PHC timestamp queue mismanagement. ice 1.11.17 is the known-bad version. Resolution path is kernel module swap via KMM.
